appearances.title: internlm/Sage-S2.1-Flash
appearances.summary: Sage S2.1 Flash is an open multimodal model for multi-round research: it takes molecular graphs, crystals, protein sequences, and 3D structures, then retrieves, codes, and checks intermediate results. SGLang and vLLM now serve it. The lab reports first place on MLE-bench Lite (90.3), OfficeQA Pro (72.2), Harvey LAB (25.0), and SpreadsheetBench 2 (37.1).
